zh: 词库和闪卡现在共用一套复习状态配色：新词灰、复习中蓝、学习中琥珀、已掌握绿。词库每行左侧那一小段色条就是这个词的状态，筛选菜单里四个状态前面也有同色圆点，不用另找图例。拖闪卡时边框会提前告诉你这一拖会把这个词送到哪个状态——左拖困难、右拖记得，边框随之变色；下拖跳过则保持当前颜色。手机上的词本横滚条也修好了：同语言的词本排在前面，从下拉切换词本后条子回到起点，不再出现「同语言词本一打开就看不见」。练习页顶部的「卡片 / 测验」「待复习 / 自定义」原来是两个挤在一起的窄胶囊，现在是整条页面级的选择条；下面选项区每行收成一行，标签在左、控件在右，不再折行错位。
en: The word library and the flashcards now share one colour language for study status: new is grey, reviewing blue, learning amber, mastered green. A short stripe on the left of each library row is that word's status, and the four status rows in the filter menu carry the same dot, so no legend is needed. While you drag a flashcard its border previews which status the word will land in when you let go — left for Hard, right for Good — while a downward drag keeps the word where it is. The wordbook strip on a phone is fixed too: same-language wordbooks now sit first, and switching wordbooks from the dropdown rewinds the strip, so they no longer open off-screen. On the practice page the Cards / Quiz and Due / Custom strips are now page-sized rather than two narrow chips squeezed together, and each option row is a single line with its label on the left and its control on the right.
